limitations: The sample name of 200923_QExHF_CR_MS726_TG3ko2 reads 'TG3ko1 DC mucus … Rep3'; the file name (ko2) and 'Rep3' are used, so it is the third Tgm3-/- replicate.
Sex and age of the mice used for the MS mucus samples are not stated (the DSS experiment used 6-8-week-old females, a different experiment).
The analysed material is one excised MUC2 band from composite agarose-PAGE of reduced mucus; this is recorded in the source names and report, not in a controlled column.
The Tgm3-/- strain background is not stated.
Methods give reduction with DTT and alkylation with iodoacetamide; the reagent columns are not included in this SDRF (the searched carbamidomethylation is annotated).
The distal-colon origin of the mucus is in the source names and this report; organism part is 'mucus'.
